question: Should the remaining controller consolidations land after representative real UI behavior proof is attached, or should this broad refactor be split further?
rationale: The refactor deliberately preserves a page-specific gateway ownership boundary after a real regression, and the protected maintainer review signal requires a human decision on whether the remaining shared-controller scope is acceptable.

options.title: Land after focused proof
options.body: Keep the current bounded scope and approve once redacted after-fix evidence demonstrates the representative lifecycle paths.

options.title: Split by lifecycle family
options.body: Separate dock layout, camera, stream-follow, and menu changes if maintainers want smaller independently reviewable risk units.

recommendation.title: Land after focused proof
recommendation.body: Keep the current bounded scope and approve once redacted after-fix evidence demonstrates the representative lifecycle paths.

likelyOwner.reason: This person authored the current refactor and the corrective revert, giving them the strongest available context on the retained ownership boundaries.
